description: The plot illustrates the maximum activation values across layers for four different components—`attn_output`, `ffn_output`, `attn_residual`, and `ffn_residual`—in a large language model architecture, likely under the “output_gate” configuration as indicated by the title. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23, representing the depth of the model’s layers, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 400 and is linearly scaled, showing the peak activation magnitude for each component at each layer. The `attn_output` (blue dashed line with circular markers) remains near zero until layer 15, then rises sharply to about 110 by layer 23. The `ffn_output` (green dash-dot line with square markers) stays close to zero until layer 18, then increases steeply to around 170 at layer 23. The `attn_residual` (orange dotted line with circular markers) begins near zero, rises gradually to about 50 by layer 15, then climbs steeply to approximately 260 at layer 23. The `ffn_residual` (solid red line) starts near zero, increases slowly to about 50 by layer 15, then surges dramatically to nearly 400 by layer 23, exhibiting the steepest growth among all components. All lines show a delayed but accelerating increase in activation toward deeper layers, with the residual components (especially `ffn_residual`) dominating in magnitude at the final layers.
